# @pdanpdan/virtual-scroll Documentation for LLMs

Virtual scrolling for Vue 3: only the rows near the viewport are in the DOM, so a list can hold any number of items. Full documentation and live examples: https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/

## Core Features
- **Virtualization**: Only the items in the viewport (plus a configurable buffer) are rendered.
- **Coordinate Scaling**: Content past the browser's scroll limit (typically 10-30M px) is mapped onto a smaller display range - virtual units (VU, the real content size) to display units (DU, what the browser can render); the threshold is `BROWSER_MAX_SIZE` (10,000,000).
- **1:1 Movement**: 1px of wheel or touch movement moves the content 1px, whatever the scale.
- **Multi-Directional**: `direction` is `vertical`, `horizontal` or `both` (grid).
- **Sizing**: one number for every item, a per-item function, a repeating array pattern (e.g. `[50, 100]`), or measured from the DOM with `ResizeObserver` (pass `null`/`0`).
- **Data-less (index-only) rows**: `items` may be a sparse array (`new Array(n)`); holes render from `index` and only the visible window is read - uniform-size lists reach 10M+ rows with flat memory and no per-row data objects.
- **Sticky Elements**: `stickyIndices` headers that stick and get pushed out by the next one, plus sticky `header`/`footer` slots. The pinning is provided by `useStickyExtension()`: with the composable, add it explicitly or `stickyIndices` only reserves the layout offsets.
- **Scroll Snapping**: `snap` prop (`'auto' | 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'next'`) aligns the view after scrolling stops.
- **Scroll Container**: its own element, or the browser `window`/`body` (`container` prop).
- **Virtual Scrollbars**: `virtualScrollbar` prop for the built-in bars, or your own through the `scrollbar` slot / `VirtualScrollbar` component.
- **Table Mode**: `VirtualScrollTable` renders `<table>` rows in real flow between engine-sized spacers (`flowTable`) with measured row heights, column pinning (`autoSizeColumns`/`columnWidths`), sticky header/footer slots and a horizontal scrollbar when the table overflows its container.
- **Masonry Mode**: `VirtualScrollMasonry` renders a masonry grid in ONE scroll container - column count and fractional column width from the container width (`targetColumnWidth`/`minColumns`/`maxColumns`/`gap`), heights from the deterministic `itemHeight` oracle (far `scrollToIndex` lands exactly without mounting the path) or from mounted cards with `measuredHeights`, segment snapshots for bounded memory, and the topmost visible card kept in place across reflows.
- **Infinite Loading**: `loading` + `loadDistance` props, `load` event and `loading` slot for pagination.
- **SSR**: `ssrRange` prop pre-renders a static in-flow block server-side for SEO, then hydrates in place.
- **Accessibility**: ARIA roles are applied for you (list, grid, tree, listbox, menu), plus keyboard navigation.
- **Authoring guidance for recycled rows**: row components are reused as items scroll in and out - keep row state in the model, render idempotently, reserve media space (`aspect-ratio`), avoid native `loading="lazy"`, and bound/deprioritise offscreen prefetch.
- **Performance**: Fenwick tree for $O(\log N)$ prefix sum and point updates.

## Installation
```bash
pnpm add @pdanpdan/virtual-scroll
```

Import the stylesheet once in your app entry - the component renders without it, but the virtual
scrollbar and container rules live there:
```ts
import '@pdanpdan/virtual-scroll/style.css';
```

`@pdanpdan/virtual-scroll/core` is the lean entry for apps that only need virtualization: the same
API compiled without the optional wiring (keyboard navigation, custom scrollbars, snapping, sticky
items, infinite loading, prepend restoration), with `@pdanpdan/virtual-scroll/core/style.css`. There
`virtualScrollbar`, `snap`, `stickyIndices`, `loadDistance` and `restoreScrollOnPrepend` are accepted
but inert, and `loading` still drives the loading slot and `aria-busy`.

Import from the package root: components, composables, extension factories and the public types.
`@pdanpdan/virtual-scroll/VirtualScroll.vue` (and `VirtualScrollTable.vue`,
`VirtualScrollMasonry.vue`, `VirtualScrollbar.vue`) expose the raw SFCs for bundlers that compile Vue
files themselves. The engine internals (pure `calculate*` helpers, DOM scroll utilities, the masonry
layout engine and their parameter bags) are importable from `@pdanpdan/virtual-scroll/internal` but
are **not** covered by semver - prefer the root entry in generated code.

## Common Patterns & Examples

### 1. Basic Vertical List
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/essential-vertical-fixed)
```vue
<VirtualScroll :items="items" :item-size="50">
  <template #item="{ item, index }">
    <div class="item">{{ index }}: {{ item.label }}</div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 2. Grid (Table/Spreadsheet)
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/essential-grid-fixed)
```vue
<VirtualScroll
  :items="items"
  direction="both"
  :column-count="10"
  :column-width="150"
  :item-size="40"
>
  <template #item="{ item, index }">
    <div class="cell">{{ item.value }}</div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 3. Chat Interface
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-chat)
Features: dynamic heights, initial scroll to bottom, scroll restoration on history load.
```vue
<VirtualScroll
  ref="virtualScrollRef"
  :items="messages"
  restore-scroll-on-prepend
  :initial-scroll-index="messages.length - 1"
  initial-scroll-align="end"
  sticky-footer
>
  <template #item="{ item }">
    <div class="chat-bubble">{{ item.text }}</div>
  </template>
  <template #footer>
    <div class="input-area"><!-- Input field here --></div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 4. Semantic HTML Table
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-table)
Uses custom tags for correct `<table>` semantics.
```vue
<VirtualScroll
  :items="items"
  container-tag="table"
  wrapper-tag="tbody"
  item-tag="tr"
  sticky-header
>
  <template #header>
    <tr><th>ID</th><th>Name</th></tr>
  </template>
  <template #item="{ item }">
    <td>{{ item.id }}</td><td>{{ item.name }}</td>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 5. Infinite Scroll
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/feature-infinite-scroll)
```vue
<VirtualScroll
  :items="items"
  :loading="isLoading"
  @load="fetchMoreItems"
>
  <template #item="{ item }">...</template>
  <template #loading>
    <div class="spinner">Loading more...</div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 6. Sticky Sections
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/feature-sticky-sections)
Section headers that stick and get pushed out by the next one.
```vue
<VirtualScroll :items="items" :sticky-indices="[0, 20, 40]">
  <template #item="{ item, isStickyActive }">
    <div :class="{ 'sticky-header': item.type === 'header', 'active': isStickyActive }">
      {{ item.label }}
    </div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 7. Data Browser
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-data-browser)
Grouped directory pattern: sticky section headers, instant search that rebuilds the section index, and jump-to navigation with configurable alignment over up to 250k records. `itemSize` can be a function returning different fixed sizes per item type (headers vs rows); pass `null` for ResizeObserver-measured dynamic sizes.
```vue
<VirtualScroll :items="items" :item-size="(item) => item.isHeader ? 40 : 64" :sticky-indices="stickyIndices" :gap="gap">
  <template #item="{ item, isStickyActive }">
    <div :class="{ 'sticky-header': item.type === 'header', 'active': isStickyActive }">
      {{ item.label }}
    </div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```

### 8. Data-less Uniform List (10M+ rows)
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/essential-vertical-fixed)
A sparse `items` placeholder plus a numeric `itemSize`: zero per-row data and constant memory at any scale. Render content from `index` only.
```vue
const items = new Array(10_000_000); // sparse placeholder, no data objects

<VirtualScroll :items="items" :item-size="40">
  <template #item="{ index }">
    <div class="item">Fixed Item {{ index }}</div>
  </template>
</VirtualScroll>
```
With sparse/holey `items` the `item` slot prop is `undefined` - derive content from `index`. ResizeObserver-measured dynamic sizes work the same way (sizes come from the rendered DOM).

### 9. Masonry Grid (single scroll container)
[Live Example](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/essential-masonry)
`VirtualScrollMasonry` virtualizes cards of a masonry layout inside one scroll container. The column count re-flows from the container width, and a reflow keeps the topmost visible card in place. Heights come from a deterministic `itemHeight` oracle - reserve media space so the rendered card matches the oracle height.
```vue
const items = ref(cards); // model holds id, aspectRatio (or height), color

// pure function of (item, index, resolved columnWidth) - MUST be deterministic
function itemHeight(item, _index, width) {
  return Math.max(60, item.height * (width / 240));
}

<VirtualScrollMasonry
  :items="items"
  :item-height="itemHeight"
  :target-column-width="240"
  :min-columns="2"
  :max-columns="8"
  :gap="16"
  @scroll="(d) => stats = d"
>
  <template #item="{ item, index, column, width, height }">
    <div class="card" :style="{ height, backgroundColor: item.color }">
      Card {{ index }} · col {{ column }} · {{ Math.round(height) }}px
    </div>
  </template>
</VirtualScrollMasonry>
```
The instance (via `ref`) exposes `scrollDetails`, `columns`, `columnWidth`, `totalHeight`, `totalHeightExact`, `scrollToIndex(index, { align, behavior })`, `scrollToOffset(offset)` and `refresh()`. By default cards must render at exactly the oracle height; with `measuredHeights` mounted cards size to their own content and drive the layout instead.

### More Example Pages
- [Masonry Grid (Essential)](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/essential-masonry): masonry in one `VirtualScrollMasonry` container - responsive column count/width, deterministic oracle heights (canonical layout), anchored reflow on resize, jump-to-card, live DOM count + column/width readouts.
- [Masonry Gallery (Pattern)](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-masonry-gallery): remote `picsum` images in one masonry container - canonical heights from each picture's `aspect-ratio`, reserved space (no layout shift on load), per-card state model-side, and a bounded low-priority prefetch batch just past the rendered window.
- [Flow Table (Essential)](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/essential-flow-table): real `<table>` rows in flow between engine-sized spacers (`flowTable`) with dynamic measured row heights, column-width modes (auto / first-window `autoSizeColumns` / explicit `columnWidths` colgroup), sticky header/footer and a horizontal scrollbar when the table overflows.
- [Scroll Snap](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/feature-scroll-snap): Snap modes on fixed and dynamic lists.
- [Window / Body Scrolling](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/essential-vertical-fixed-body): Virtualize using the browser window as scroll container.
- [Scroll Restoration](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/feature-scroll-restoration): Restore scroll position when items are prepended (`usePrependRestorationExtension`; `useSnapshotsExtension` saves/restores an explicit position).
- Keyboard & a11y: `keyboardActivation` (`'auto' | 'item' | 'viewport'`) selects between viewport scrolling and a roving active item; the item model publishes `aria-activedescendant`, the `isActive` item slot prop, a polite live region and the `itemActivate` event (`activeIndex`/`setActiveIndex`/`handleItemActivate` on the instance).
- `load` carries `{ velocity, direction }`: `flingVelocity` (VU/ms) suppresses loading mid-fling and `preload` (VU) loads ahead in the travel direction.
- [SSR](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/feature-ssr): Server-rendered static range that hydrates into virtual scrolling.
- [Custom Scrollbar](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/feature-custom-scrollbar): Styling the built-in virtual scrollbar.
- [Independent Scrollbars](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/feature-independent-scrollbars): Grid with separately draggable axis scrollbars.
- [Layout Switcher](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-layout-switcher): one dataset rendered as a virtualized list (one item per record), a two-axis grid (`direction="both"` + `columnCount`, items grouped into rows) or a flow table (`flowTable`, sticky header) - only the virtualization unit and the geometry props change, the data and the `@scroll` contract stay the same.
- [Tree](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-tree) / [Gallery](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-gallery) / [Draggable](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-draggable) / [Search](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-search) / [Diff](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-diff) / [Spreadsheet](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-spreadsheet): Advanced pattern recipes.
- [Configurator](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/configurator): Live playground that generates code snippets for list, table (`VirtualScrollTable`) or masonry (`VirtualScrollMasonry`) rendering - component SFC, composable tab (table/masonry output uses the component), CodePen/TypeScript and standalone HTML; table column widths in auto / first-window (`autoSizeColumns`) / custom colgroup modes; masonry column geometry from target width + min/max columns.
- [Log Viewer](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-log-viewer): 200k lazy generated lines, level filter + debounced search, filtered index rebuild.
- [Code Viewer](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-code-viewer): virtualized real C++ source (the simdutf file from the code diff example, ~10.5k lines), find-next jumps and highlights matching terms.
- [Live Streaming](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-streaming): simulated market feed; each tick mutates only the visible window of 5,000 symbols (lazy per-row state), pause/resume and speed controls.
- [Async Content](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/pattern-async-content): rows are ids rendered by a component that fetches simulated content (module-level cache, single in-flight per id), dynamic measured heights, network profile + cache controls.


## Component API Highlights

### Props
- `items`: `T[]` (Required) - Data to virtualize; may be sparse (`undefined` entries) for index-only lists - holes render and the slot `item` is `undefined` for them.
- `itemSize`: `number | (number | null | undefined)[] | ((item, index) => number) | null` (Omitted/`null`/`0` = rows measured via `ResizeObserver`; `40` is only the pre-measure estimate) - arrays define repeating circular patterns; `null`/holes in the array mean "measure this index".
- `direction`: `'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both'`.
- `columnCount` / `columnWidth`: Grid mode columns (also accepts arrays/functions/`null` for dynamic).
- `container`: `HTMLElement | Window` - Scroll container; pass the `window` object for window/body scrolling.
- `snap`: `boolean | 'auto' | 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'next'` (Default: `false`).
- `stickyIndices` / `stickyHeader` / `stickyFooter`: Sticky sections and edge slots.
- `loading` / `loadDistance`: Infinite-loading threshold and state.
- `virtualScrollbar`: `boolean` - Force virtual scrollbars even when browser limits aren't hit.
- `restoreScrollOnPrepend`: `boolean` - Prevents "jumping" when adding items to the top.
- `keyboardActivation`: `'auto' | 'item' | 'viewport'` (Default: `'auto'`) - `'auto'` tracks a roving active item for `listbox`/`menu`/`tree` and scrolls the viewport otherwise.
- `ssrRange`: `{ start: number, end: number, colStart?: number, colEnd?: number }` - Pre-render specific items for SEO/SSR.

### Exposed Methods (via Ref)
- `scrollToIndex(row, col?, options?)`: Options include `align: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'auto'` and `behavior: 'auto' | 'smooth'`.
- `scrollToOffset(x, y, options?)`: Programmatic pixel-based scroll. Options: `behavior`, plus `endExtraX`/`endExtraY` (VU) to extend the scroll clamp past the content end for a block rendered after the items (e.g. an always-rendered loading slot).
- `refresh()`: Resets all internal measurements (useful if items change size externally).

## Technical Implementation Details

### Coordinate Scaling (VU vs DU)
When the total size exceeds the browser's limit (10 million pixels, `BROWSER_MAX_SIZE`), the library calculates a `scale` factor:
`scale = Virtual_Total_Size / Browser_Max_Limit`
The browser's native scrollbar moves through `DU` (Display Units), while items are positioned and rendered in `VU` (Virtual Units).
Positioning formula: `translateY(VU_offset - (DU_scroll * scale))`

### Performance Optimization
- **Fenwick Tree**: Stores and updates item sizes. Prefix sums (the offset of the Nth item) and point updates (a size change) are both $O(\log N)$.
- **Incremental growth**: Appending items resizes the tree incrementally (no full rebuild per batch), and initialization only revisits regions that actually changed.
- **Uniform sizes need no storage**: A numeric `itemSize` / `columnWidth` resolves positions arithmetically (O(1)) - no per-row arrays are allocated, so fixed-size lists run at 10M+ rows with flat memory.
- **Index-only lists**: Sparse `items` render every index in range; only the visible window is read, so rows can render from `index` alone.
- **ResizeObserver**: Tracks size changes of mounted items, updates the Fenwick tree, and adjusts the layout only when something actually moved.

## CSS Variables for Styling
Customize the default virtual scrollbar:
- `--vs-scrollbar-size`: width/height of the scrollbar.
- `--vs-scrollbar-bg`: track color.
- `--vs-scrollbar-thumb-bg`: thumb color.
- `--vs-scrollbar-radius`: border radius.

## UMD Stand-alone Examples
- [Grid Dynamic](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/essential-grid-dynamic.html): Rows and columns virtualized at once, with column widths read from the DOM.
- [Grid Fixed](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/essential-grid-fixed.html): Rows and columns virtualized at once with a fixed itemSize and alternating columnWidth values.
- [Horizontal Dynamic](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/essential-horizontal-dynamic.html): Horizontal list of items whose widths are measured with ResizeObserver.
- [Horizontal Fixed](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/essential-horizontal-fixed.html): Horizontal list of uniform-width items, with the row height filled automatically.
- [Vertical Dynamic](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/essential-vertical-dynamic.html): Vertical list of variable-height rows, measured with ResizeObserver.
- [Vertical Fixed](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/essential-vertical-fixed.html): Vertical list of uniform-height rows; only the rows in the viewport are rendered.
- [Custom Scrollbar](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/feature-custom-scrollbar.html): Virtual scrollbars drawn inside the container, styled with CSS variables or your own markup.
- [Infinite Scroll](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/feature-infinite-scroll.html): Automatic pagination with the load event and the loading slot.
- [Sticky Sections](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/feature-sticky-sections.html): Section headers that stick to the top and get pushed out by the next one.
- [Chat Interface](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/pattern-chat.html): Chat with bubble heights measured from the DOM, opening at the bottom, and history loading without moving the view.
- [Table](https://pdanpdan.github.io/virtual-scroll/umd/pattern-table.html): Virtualized rows in real table markup, for accessible tabular data.
